newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market steady-up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market steady-up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were $1.00 per cwt higher and dressed basis sales were steady to $1.00 higher, USDA said.
Buyer inquiry continued strong. Seller interest was limited by the fact that most showlists already traded.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights )
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs - multiple pens in far Western area 70.00, few others 68.50-69.00; dressed basis 112.00, few 113.00. ( weighted average 112.07 ).
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1250 lbs - multiple pens in far Western area 70.00, few 69.50; dressed basis 112.00, few 112.50. ( weighted average 112.04 )
For week - 76,300 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 77,900 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 24,000
